machines.purpose: Convert explicit goals or Workshop Direction plans into exact research requirements.
machines.failureRecovery: Reject malformed or capability-free goals without changing source state.

machines.purpose: Inventory declared Workshop capabilities and typed structural gaps from current files.
machines.failureRecovery: Unreadable optional sources become absent or unknown; the tool root is required.
machines.verification: Fixture Workshop and live contract/seam audit.

machines.purpose: Compare exact goal requirements with the declared inventory and merge observed Workshop gaps.
machines.failureRecovery: Reject duplicates and malformed identifiers; never fuzzy-match a requirement green.

machines.purpose: Turn each typed gap into one falsifiable research question.
machines.failureRecovery: Unknown gap types receive an observation-first question.
machines.verification: One stable question per gap and no truth promotion.

machines.purpose: Select the cheapest honest reuse, verify, adapt, improve, build, substrate, or authority hypothesis.
machines.failureRecovery: Token-overlap leads remain explicitly unverified and never close gaps.
machines.verification: Route precedence and fuzzy-lead non-satisfaction fixtures.

machines.purpose: Design the cheapest disconfirming test on the evidence surface native to each claim.
machines.failureRecovery: Unknown claim kinds route to an explicit missing-verifier state.

machines.purpose: Rank transparent builder and steward queues without assigning work.
machines.failureRecovery: Stable identifier ordering breaks score ties.
machines.verification: Ordering, factor transparency, and no-assignment assertions.

machines.purpose: Ingest digest-bound observations and preserve contradictions instead of averaging them.
machines.failureRecovery: Reject unknown claims, duplicate observations, missing digests, and broken chains.
machines.verification: PASS/FAIL conflict and tamper fixtures plus fresh-process reload.

machines.purpose: Compile machine-readable and builder-readable research reports with stable semantic digests.
machines.failureRecovery: Refuse incomplete composition upstream; never hide FAIL or UNKNOWN.
machines.verification: Same semantic inputs yield same research digest across observation timestamps.

machines.purpose: Compose all research machines without merging their state or authority.
machines.failureRecovery: A failed stage aborts the run and leaves source state untouched.
machines.verification: End-to-end seeded gap and live Workshop runs.

machines.purpose: Render the latest report for human and machine collaborators without mutating it.
machines.failureRecovery: Show a visible missing-report state and never invent fallback findings.
machines.verification: Laptop/mobile render, queue switching, overflow, and missing-report checks.
